title: 2D layered VSe2 with high pseudocapacitive Zn-ion storage as a cathode for high-power zinc-ion batteries

2D layered VSe2–MWCNT with high pseudocapacitive-mediated Zn-ion storage is studied as a cathode for aqueous Zn-ion battery. Favourable interlayer spacing & structural defects boost Zn-ion storage with a dominant capacitive-controlled storage.
